dataRule: Use the verified existing application database and storage only; no new count database and no inference from preview variables.
activationRules: Verify official external database/storage access permission
Verify readiness and protocol from Beelink
Send one genuine original event without changing its date/id/hash
Read back same row and image in the existing dashboard
Verify controlled replay does not duplicate the row
Enable one durable transport only after acceptance
Enable deferred analysis after its production scope is verified
